about: SQL native dev copies from the supatype/postgres image (packages/cli/src/native-roles-sql.ts). Each file here is a copy of `source` in the supatype-postgres repo at `commit`, its LF-normalised sha256 recorded; each line is one the CLI copies verbatim. tests/native-image-sql.test.ts checks the CLI against these copies, and scripts/check-image-sql.mjs checks these copies against a supatype-postgres checkout, for either repo's CI.

lines.text: ALTER ROLE postgres SET search_path TO "$user",public,extensions;
